name: browser-use
headline: My GTD Buddy - Automate GTD Workflows
short_description: A Reminders-native Getting Things Done (GTD) workflow powered by Claude Code. This project implements a streamlined GTD system using Apple Reminders with an intelligent AI skill to orchestrate workflow management
author: realYushi

sections.overview:
My GTD Buddy implements David Allen's Getting Things Done methodology as a Claude Code skill that orchestrates Apple Reminders as your task management system. It automates the four core GTD phases—capture, process, execute, and review—with context tags (@home, @office) and energy levels (#high, #low, #quick) embedded in task notes. The system tracks historical patterns like processing velocity and peak productivity days to surface relevant tasks based on your current context and energy, while integrating macOS Calendar for appointment-aware scheduling. It supports undo operations, project health detection, waiting item nudges, and batch operations for stale items, making it ideal for professionals juggling multiple projects who want structured workflows without switching apps.
Daily inbox processing: converting captured ideas into actionable next steps with energy matching
Context-aware task selection: filtering tasks by location (@home, @office) and energy level during execution
Weekly project reviews: identifying orphaned projects without next actions and assessing system health
Post-vacation recovery: batch processing stale items and resetting workflow patterns
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/realYushi/my-gtd-buddy`
sections.usage:
```
Act as my GTD Buddy. I'll share my current tasks from Apple Reminders, and you'll help me organize them using the GTD methodology. Here's my current list: [TASKS]. Please categorize these tasks into: Next Actions, Waiting, Projects, or Someday/Maybe. For each category, provide a clear breakdown and suggest any additional steps or clarifications needed.
```
